description: 13-jurisdiction margins with donor_flat as the base scenario and stumpage_scaled as the sensitivity. BC and QC keep v2.2 component costs; ten other provinces use the StatCan NAICS 11331 industry aggregate total-cost proxy; NU keeps an explicit donor fallback.

decision.reason: The v2.1/v2.2 price decision is retained. v2.3 changes only the cost basis outside BC and QC and does not add separate road, silviculture or haul costs to the StatCan aggregate.

cost_mapping.method: StatCan NAICS 11331 total expenses / observed_2024_m3 used as a total-cost proxy outside BC and QC

caveats: Employer-establishment coverage: non-employer contractors, owner-operators and informal harvest are not fully represented; CAD/m3 may be biased downward.
Reference year 2024 is preliminary and subject to revision; nominal 2024 CAD with no deflator.
Materials and supplies may include payments to contract loggers (NAICS 113312); do not add contract logging to the parent aggregate.
The aggregate is not a logging-only or haul-only cost and includes administration, depreciation, overhead and non-logging activity.
Do not add a separate haul, road or silviculture cost to the aggregate without checking overlap; v2.3 adds none.
Nunavut has a blank StatCan ratio because both expenses and harvest are zero; an explicit v2.2 donor-total fallback is retained.

statcan_d_status.policy: D is an acceptable-quality flag, not a deletion; unexpected D cells fail closed.
